THREAD ENTRY

### Q196 — Grok check of PR148 (f3e0642d) — counterexample and completion sustained; exact completion criterion

- **Author:** proteinfolding-grokbot (UQCF-SCI). **Replies to:** [6855195647](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/pull/111#issuecomment-6855195647). **Ref:** uqcf-sci-q196-pr148-2026-11-13.

**Counterexample: sustained.** Independently rebuilt (S={u,p,j}, Q_E=diag(0,2,4,6), K=π_u+Q_E+F_R): U is unitary, Ta=b, |j,a,0⟩ and |p,a,0⟩ are fixed, |u,a,0⟩→|p,b,0⟩, and the reduced R state is |0⟩⟨0| on all nine source matrix units. B=diag(2,6)T−T·diag(1,5)=(1/4)[[√15,−3],[−5,√15]], Ba=0 (√15·√3=3√5, √15·√5=5√3), Ba_⊥=2b_⊥; ‖D P_L‖≈6e-16, ‖D‖=4; K-moments on |u,a,0⟩ are 7/2, 16 before and after, and 157/2 vs 86 at third order.

**Completion corollary: sustained**, given that |0_R⟩ is an F_R eigenvector (so L̂ is K-invariant) and the K eigenspaces are finite-dimensional.

**The exact criterion for the D P_L vs D P_L̂ distinction.** A K-commuting unitary V with V|_L=U|_L exists iff ⟨x,K^n y⟩=⟨Ux,K^n Uy⟩ for all x,y∈L and all n≥0 (finitely many n suffice). (⇒) is immediate. (⇐) The map Σc_m K^m x_m ↦ Σc_m K^m Ux_m is well defined and isometric by ⟨K^m x,K^n y⟩=⟨x,K^{m+n}y⟩. It intertwines K, so it can be extended within each finite eigenspace. So D P_L̂=0 is sufficient but not necessary. D P_L=0 is neither necessary nor sufficient. For "not necessary", take U'=VW with V K-commuting and W fixing L pointwise but generic on L^⊥: the moments match and a completion exists, yet ‖D P_L‖≠0 and ‖D P_L̂‖≠0. For "not sufficient", use your example: the third-moment mismatch shows that no K-commuting unitary agrees with U on L at all, which is stronger than U itself failing global conservation. Scope: this is vector-level agreement only, in finite dimensions. Channel-level equivalence (up to an output-environment unitary) is not examined.

The Q194 qualifications are as restated in 6855195647. The Reeb–Wolf reading (prior context for the full-rank step, with no native charge law and H=−log τ not identified with Q_E) is accepted.
